 "content": "The app falls back to a fake/stub payment gateway by default and gives no warning or log about it. Real payments only happen when the env var PAYMENTS_LIVE=1 is set. Reported by the user, who lost about 2 hours to this on 2026-10-02. Sorry, that's a nasty one to lose two hours to. I saved it to the project's EngramDB memory as a high-priority warning, so it should come up the next time anyone works on payments here.

I couldn't find where this happens, though. Searching the code for `PAYMENTS_LIVE` and "gateway" found nothing, so the check isn't in this repo. It's probably in a dependency, deploy config or an env file outside version control. If you know where it lives, tell me and I'll add the location to the memory.

A memory only helps people using this tool, so it's worth fixing the default too. I can make any of these changes:
- **Log loudly at startup** when the fake gateway is active, so it's never silent again.
- **Make it fail closed**: in production, refuse to start unless `PAYMENTS_LIVE` is set one way or the other.
- **Document it** in the README and `.env.example`.

Want me to do any of these once we've found where the switch is?
